retrievalProfile.description: A soft-focus, 1980s-style romantic portrait featuring a subject in white lace against a pink textured wall with dappled shadows.
triggerTerms: dappled leaf shadows on pink wall

recipe.visualDefinition: A dreamy, low-contrast scene centered on a woman in a white lace dress seated on a terrace. The background is a textured pink wall bathed in soft, dappled sunlight filtered through foliage, creating a hazy, nostalgic atmosphere with a secondary figure lying in the foreground.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject in white lace contrasting against a warm pink textured background
Dappled shadows from a climbing vine creating rhythmic patterns on the wall
Soft-focus haze unifying the foreground and background elements
Triangular composition formed by the seated subject and the horizontal foreground figure
coreInvariants: Soft, diffused lighting with dappled leaf shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central seated figure, medium shot, occupying the middle ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The seated subject's face and hand-to-head pose.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the vertical vine on the left, across the dappled wall to the subject's face, then down to the reclining figure in the foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large expanse of textured wall on the left and top, providing breathing room for the soft lighting effects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Dusty rose and mauve (wall and shadows)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep indigo and dark green (denim and foliage)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high key with soft shadows; values are compressed to maintain a hazy look.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to pastels and earth tones
